All fixture texts and PDF files are original fictional content created for ResearchBench and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. They contain no real personal data. Regenerate deterministically with `node tests/fixtures/generate-fixtures.mjs`.

The three numbered PDFs are valid text-based, two-page PDF 1.4 documents. `expected.json` contains reference questions, answers and page anchors. `textless.pdf` is a valid empty page; `corrupt.pdf` is intentionally broken. TXT tests Unicode spans; Markdown tests safe source rendering and blocked remote images.
